verdict.rationale: The evidence describes no built-in AI assistant inside the ElevenAgents dashboard that the user can delegate tasks to. The hosted MCP server and the agents skill let external assistants such as Claude or coding assistants manage agents, but those are outside clients, not an in-product assistant. The agents the product builds serve end customers rather than the platform user.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
